topics.title: AI Agents
topics.note: deep-dive discussion version approved by Sufi on 2026-11-08

topics.title: Agent Skills: how AI learns a new job from a folder
topics.angle: What a skill is (a folder with instructions + scripts the agent loads when needed); why it beats one giant prompt; example skill; Anthropic donated the Agent Skills standard to the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF), so it is becoming an open standard.

topics.title: Can AI read your mind? Rebuilding what you see from brain scans
topics.angle: Brain scan while a person looks at images -> model learns the mapping -> reconstructs a new image; what it can and cannot do; privacy concerns. Verify every claim on the MIT Technology Review article / the paper.

topics.title: How AI agents get hacked (prompt injection)
topics.angle: Agents read files and web pages and can't always tell data from instructions; real example: malicious AGENTS.md files in Downloads folders made agents install a malicious NPM package; 5 safety habits (separate working folders, approve installs, least-privilege tools, review actions, trusted sources).

topics.title: Always-on AI: agents that work without being asked
topics.angle: Reactive chat vs proactive agents that run in the cloud, watch for triggers and act; OpenAI dots (always on, own browser and tools); what this means and the approval/safety trade-offs. Verify launches on primary sources before using them.

topics.title: GEO: how to get your business recommended by AI search
topics.angle: Search is moving into AI answers; what generative engine optimization is; Google's 2026 guide calling AEO/GEO 'still SEO'; practical checklist (clear facts, structured pages, reviews, cited sources).

topics.title: A 24-billion-parameter AI on your phone: how AI got small
topics.angle: Why big models used to need data centres; compression/quantization (Gemma 4 E4B shrunk to 5 GB); mixture-of-experts with few active parameters (Liquid LFM2.5-24B-A2B: 24B total, 2B active); benefits: privacy, offline, speed.
